methodReview: Authors used adults only; both sexes were included and source studies were not uniformly sex-specific.
Values are peak frequencies of reported signals, excluding harmonics and formants; they are not hearing limits.
Most studies cover repertoires, but 21 single-call studies concern contact calls. Do not present a contact-call-only upper endpoint as the species maximum voice pitch.
Original study conditions, call context, species identity and completeness need review. No suffix, genus or subspecies transfers.
Body mass, log columns, model outputs and binary sociality are not admitted.
Retain released cached values without inventing extra measured precision.
